title: fix(runtime): the base's package export leaves out its pair's dashboard and report overrides (#29563)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8CS9iUSJwYcxNgNAu6nCtWs)_
Fixes #29563

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:基础包的导出 `GET /packages/BASE/export` 不再夹带 `.custom` 配对包已发布的仪表盘、报表覆盖项;配对包的导出照旧带覆盖项和 `overrides` 声明。
- 为什么改:ADR-0146 D8 第 3 条要求基础包导出「原样」;视图已经如此,仪表盘和报表却把客户的改动写进了厂商的包文件,无法当作厂商包重新部署。
- 风险与回滚:只在导出时多过滤一类条目(声明「覆盖本包」的条目),其余读取不变;回滚即撤回本 PR 的一个 commit。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `declaresOverrideOf` 与 `assemblePackageManifest` 里的那一行过滤;再看新测试 `packages-export-base-unchanged-per-type.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/domains/packages-export-base-unchanged-per-type.integration.test.ts`,预期 3 条全绿(视图、仪表盘、报表)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`assemblePackageManifest` (the `GET /packages/:id/export` door) now leaves out, from a package's own export read through the per-package layer, any item whose `overrides.package` names that same package. A package's own document never declares that it overrides itself: that declaration is what an item of the base's `.custom` pair carries. The pair's export is unchanged and keeps the overriding item with its `overrides` block. A protocol with no per-package layer is read as before, so the existing CONTROL in `packages-export-per-package-layer.test.ts` stays as it is.

One `@objectstack/runtime` patch changeset.

## Why

ADR-0146 D8 item 3: "`GET /packages/hotcrm.custom/export` carries the overriding item with its `overrides` block; `GET /packages/hotcrm/export` carries the base unchanged."

Measured red first on the real protocol and engine (new pin, before the fix), per type:

- view: the base's export carried only the base's document (already correct);
- dashboard: `expected [ 'Shipped label', 'Edited label' ] to deeply equal [ 'Shipped label' ]`;
- report: `expected [ 'Shipped label', 'Edited label' ] to deeply equal [ 'Shipped label' ]`.

Where the second item comes from, read off the registry in the same harness: publishing the pair's row writes it through to the SchemaRegistry's bare slot (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`). The artifact lookup there falls back to the base's code artifact, because the pair ships no artifact of that name, so the bare copy wears the base's envelope (`_packageId` = the base, `_provenance: 'package'`). `listItems(type, BASE)` then answers both the base's composite entry and that copy, and the per-package layer lists both under the base. Views are spared by the #22057 guard in the same hydrator, which is view-only by its own comment.

The upstream (the hydrator lending a base's envelope to its pair's row) is in `protocol.ts`, which is frozen until 2026-11-03 06:00Z and outside this card's claim. It is reported in the card's os-dev-report as a follow-up, with the minimal change named. This PR closes the export contract at the door the card names.

**ADR-0146 D8 item 2, "the export of X's app surface":** read here as the pair's export, the one that carries X's app surface as customized, not as `GET /packages/X/export`. Item 3 names that route and gives it the opposite rule, and `getMetaItemsPerPackage`'s docblock (`protocol.ts`) and #28409 read it the same way. The ADR text is not edited here (outside the claim); the report names the clarifying sentence for the seat.

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-base-unchanged-per-type.integration.test.ts`: the real door (`HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`) over the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `ObjectQL` on a SQLite file. The base is a code package, the pair is installed through the package door, each override goes through the draft save and the per-item publish. Per type (view, dashboard, report): the effective read serves the override (CONTROL), the base's export carries only the base's document with no `overrides` block, and the pair's export carries the override with its declaration.
- Ablation (fix committed first, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the test reads `packages.ts` from source, no dist in the path): deleting the filter line turned dashboard and report red with the same two messages above, view stayed green; restore proved `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display` acceptance[4] is a live-run checklist item; its record is not edited in this PR (outside the claim). The seat can mark it once a live run reads the base export clean.
